description: Inventaire des Ouvrages d'Art sur le réseau routier national en Guyane is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.geoguyane.fr. A work of art is a construction of great importance led by the establishment of a channel of communication. The data lists the works of art known on the national road network of Guyana. The data geolocates the works of art on the national road network in French Guiana. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Inventory of Artworks on the national road network in French Guiana" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
